To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) farm and ranch operators are at risk for injury and illness from a variety of hazards and exposures; 2) farm and ranch operator injury rates are lower than those in many industries but are higher than the rates of many other occupational groups; and 3) farm and ranch injury and illness rates are higher than the general population rates.
farm and ranch operators have a high risk of injury.
